representation_formats.R0: dated cumulative observations and evidenced daily increments

common_parse_contract.result_protocol: value, no_result, or rejected; evidence IDs refer only to returned values

metadata.artifacts: PCA scaling and loadings are fitted once to declared training fires and frozen. No per-query or evaluation-data fitting.
metadata.completeness: The primary profile requires at least three complete consecutive evidenced daily increments and positive reconstructed total. A multi-day difference is interval growth, not a daily rate.
metadata.limitations: Truncated standardized PCA is a statistical representation, not a neural embedding or exact inverse. PCA neighbors are geometry diagnostics, not independently validated scientific analogs.
metadata.normalization: Upstream normalized allocation is integrated by mass-conserving rebinning into 20 bins. Absolute size, native dates and sequence length are intentionally absent from the materialized shape view. Validated primary-profile provenance retains source-ID counts, so consecutive sequence length can be obtained from that metadata rather than inverted from normalized values.

operation_contracts.cumulative: Observed cumulative area at an available source date; only original-value access preserves absolute area.
operation_contracts.daily_growth: One evidenced calendar-day increment. Missing observations, gaps and unknown baseline yield no result.
operation_contracts.front_fraction: Fraction of allocation in the first half of the completed developmental sequence.
operation_contracts.interval_growth: Difference of available cumulative endpoints; an interval total is not a daily rate.
operation_contracts.maximum_daily_growth: Maximum evidenced increment of a complete consecutive sequence, including observed zeros.
operation_contracts.nearest_profile: Full-profile Euclidean neighbor fidelity. PCA backprojection is an explicit approximation.
operation_contracts.pca_distance: Distance in the declared frozen standardized PCA geometry, not a scientific analog label.
operation_contracts.peak_date: Native date of the first maximal evidenced daily increment; native dates need original-value access.
operation_contracts.profile: 20-bin mass-conserving allocation for >=3 complete consecutive daily increments with positive total.
operation_contracts.profile_distance: Exact unscaled Euclidean distance of full 20-bin profiles; truncated PCA is not an exact inverse.
operation_contracts.pulses: Upstream padded 20%-prominence pulse count and native dates; locations require native dates.
operation_contracts.scientific_analog: Independent scientific analog relevance requires external relevance evidence; geometry alone is insufficient.
operation_contracts.sequence_days: For a validated consecutive profile, the source-ID sidecar count gives the number of evidenced daily intervals.

metadata.operations: All callable IDs/signatures are identical across metadata views. Rich metadata explains preconditions; it does not enable more powerful execution. Use cumulative/interval/daily operations only on evidenced values; return abstention for unavailable observations, undefined normalization or insufficient representations. Independent analog labels remain unavailable.
metadata.provenance: Source/version/rights and source-observation IDs survive in opaque lineage. Source checksum scope is explicit. Synthetic fixtures have no real-world measurement validity.
metadata.quality: Missing, gap, observed_zero_growth and availability_time_unknown flags remain explicit. Unknown data-availability times do not support operational forecasting.
metadata.variables: Area remains km2 and daily increment km2/day. No inferred baseline, imputation, unit conversion or future information.

operation_contracts.cumulative: Observed cumulative area at an available source date; only original-value access preserves absolute area.
operation_contracts.daily_growth: One evidenced calendar-day increment. Missing observations, gaps and unknown baseline yield no result.
operation_contracts.front_fraction: Fraction of allocation in the first half of the completed developmental sequence.
operation_contracts.interval_growth: Difference of available cumulative endpoints; an interval total is not a daily rate.
operation_contracts.maximum_daily_growth: Maximum evidenced increment of a complete consecutive sequence, including observed zeros.
operation_contracts.nearest_profile: Full-profile Euclidean neighbor fidelity. PCA backprojection is an explicit approximation.
operation_contracts.pca_distance: Distance in the declared frozen standardized PCA geometry, not a scientific analog label.
operation_contracts.peak_date: Native date of the first maximal evidenced daily increment; native dates need original-value access.
operation_contracts.profile: 20-bin mass-conserving allocation for >=3 complete consecutive daily increments with positive total.
operation_contracts.profile_distance: Exact unscaled Euclidean distance of full 20-bin profiles; truncated PCA is not an exact inverse.
operation_contracts.pulses: Upstream padded 20%-prominence pulse count and native dates; locations require native dates.
operation_contracts.scientific_analog: Independent scientific analog relevance requires external relevance evidence; geometry alone is insufficient.
operation_contracts.sequence_days: For a validated consecutive profile, the source-ID sidecar count gives the number of evidenced daily intervals.
